infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_wrenchscrewdriver: A dual-purpose repair tool designed for easy carrying by submarine maintainers, which can be conveniently switched between wrench and screwdriver by ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_electricnailgun: Equipped with a magnetic hammer inside, it is capable of firing nail bullets continuously.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_nailmagazine: A container designed for holding and feeding nail bullets.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_torch: A long, sturdy stick designed to illuminate dark areas. It can be ignited or extinguished by ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_laserpointer: Effectively increases the accuracy of the ranged weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_flashlightchampio: Shining on targets' heads will blind them and slow them down.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_crankcharger: The electricity generated by turning the crank is stored in an inserted battery, and the integrated high-efficiency bulb can emit light almost indefinitely.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_militarysurvivalb: With its large capacity, waterproof and hanging design, it can carry numerous items while keeping the interior dry in various harsh environments. In addition, it integrates a power distribution system, charging bank, and lighting module, providing sufficient protection for the user's survival needs.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_lighter: Maybe it can be used to ignite something.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_cigar: It is made of tobacco shreds, alkaloids extracted from opium and appropriate antagonists. Smoking it has the effect of calming nerves and relieving pain.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_throwingknife: A compact, lightweight and convenient knife crafted from high-quality steel that ensures having swift, balanced, and stable usage in CQC. It can inflict ‖color:gui.orange‖Deep Wound‖end‖ on the target's limbs.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolversa: A .38 caliber revolver with semi-automatic firing mode.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverdemonsbet: An enchanted .38 caliber revolver with an inscription on the gun body and a non-normally-functional trigger mechanism; therefore, it can only be activated through roulette-like, 0.666% chance of blood loss per attempt to shoot, and if the chamber is empty when firing, the weapon temporarily gains 66.6% additional firepower and 6.66% penetration until the loaded round is removed from the cylinder.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverburst: A .38 caliber revolver that drives the cylinder and the hammer via the micro motor. After numerous iterations of prototypes, it has successfully reduced the firing failure rates, including bursting and jamming, to within standard limits, significantly enhancing the reliability and safety of shooting.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_incendiumrevolver: A .38 caliber revolver crafted from alien materials. It is capable of igniting .38 caliber bullets.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_civilrifle: A market-oriented sporting rifle, similar to its military counterpart in appearance and performance, has high accuracy and range, making it suitable for hunting, shooting, and other occasions.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_sniperrifle: A long-range rifle designed for snipers, featuring a longer barrel for greater accuracy and stability.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_incendiumsmg: A .45 caliber submachine gun crafted from alien materials. It generates heat during firing. When the weapon overheats, ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖ to activate barrage mode, which significantly increases the weapon's firing rate and damage, and it will be capable of igniting the target until it cools down. Additionally, you can select the ‖color:gui.white‖Automatic Barrage‖end‖ option to automatically transition the weapon into barrage mode upon reaching certain degree of overheating.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_bullpupassaultrif: It adopts a three-round burst-fire mechanism and has excellent combat capabilities in narrow combat environments.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_assaultrifle2: An assault rifle equipped with an underslung grenade launcher. It supports attack modes of melee and ranged, which can be switched by ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖. By selecting the ‖color:gui.white‖Grenade Launcher‖end‖ option, you will be able to shoot grenade (with high priority).
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_hammerheadhmg: A 5.56mm caliber heavy machine gun. As the name suggests, the gun has been modified by the separatists to improve accuracy and stability at the cost of reducing the starting fire rate.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_deathslinger: You can switch the attack mode (melee or ranged) by ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖. At short intervals, a special harpoon with bloodlet effect is reloaded, and upon hitting the target, it will inflict ‖color:gui.orange‖Deep Wound‖end‖; attacking in melee mode will immediately trigger all ‖color:gui.orange‖Deep Wound‖end‖ effects on the target.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_compoundcrossbow: It uses advanced multi-layer composite materials and multi-functional rails, with excellent range and high accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_compoundcrossbowb: Thanks to the unique firing mechanism of the compound crossbow, it has higher kinetic energy and penetration than pistol bullets.
Equipped with a miniature electromagnetic pulse bomb that is detonated by an impact fuse and damages nearby electrical equipment when it explodes.
Equipped with a miniature acid bomb that is detonated by an impact fuse and causes acid burns when it explodes.
Equipped with an IFF module, it will ignore hits on friendly forces.
Equipped with an active muscle phagotroph injector that will erode the target's biological tissue.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_bloodletspear: A special harpoon is coated with a biological toxin extracted and purified from the swarmfeeder. It has bloodlet effect, which prevents the target's blood vessels from contracting and blood-clotting, thereby resulting in continuous bloodloss.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverroundsoft: A .38 round for the revolver, spreading upon impacts with flesh to cause a larger wound but with low penetration.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverroundblun: A .38 round for the revolver, which has low lethality and is mainly used to incapacitate the target.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverroundsnak: A .38 round for the revolver, designed for pest control, which has low power but inflicts significant blood loss on flesh.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverroundop: A .38 overpressure round for the revolver, which is powerful and has enough penetration, but with slightly less accuracy due to the over-pressurization of the relatively light round.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_revolverroundredc: A .38 round for the revolver, being enchanted by clown power, which has the effect of reducing the afflictions on the target. Praise the Honkmother!
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_handcannonroundsh: A .61 revolver round featuring shorter shell, less powder, and slightly lighter weight, making it easier to manufacture and more economical.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_handcannonroundop: A .61 overpressure revolver round, which is powerful but slightly less accurate.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_shotgunshelltarge: Ammunition for a shotgun with a small charge and pellets, which is easy to carry and used for sports, pest control, or target practice.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_shotgunshellslug: Ammunition for a shotgun featuring concentrated damage and high accuracy, which is designed to extend the versatility of the shotgun, in order to compensate for the low firepower at longer ranges.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_shotgunshellflech: Ammunition for a shotgun loaded with a small number of steel darts, which boast strong penetrating power and intensive fire spread, causing heavy bleeding to living targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_shotgunshelldrago: Ammunition for a shotgun consisting of magnesium particles, solid combustion agent and metal fragments, which has extremely high lethality against close-range targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_shotgunshellstar: Ammunition for a shotgun that produces a blinding directional burst of light to impede the target's vision.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_riflebulletap: A .30 caliber round for the rifle with higher penetration but slightly lower damage, which can cause ‖color:gui.orange‖Deep Wound‖end‖ to the target.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_riflebulletsurplu: A .30 caliber surplus round for the rifle cleared from the ammunition inventory due to substandard quality or expiration of the shelf life.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_riflebulletop: A .30 overpressure round for the rifle with higher lethality but slightly less accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_smgmagazineext: A magazine with expanded capacity of 31 for .45 caliber SMG rounds is made of titanium alloy instead of cheap steel but it is expensive and cannot be convenient to store.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_smgmagazineop: A compact magazine for .45 overpressure SMG rounds, marked with an orange band to indicate the powder charge. The ammunition is extremely powerful and penetrating, but due to the expensive price, only low-capacity specifications are adopted.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_assaultrifledrumm: A drum-type magazine with expanded capacity of 60 designed for holding 6.8mm cartridges. It boasts a large capacity and does not require frequent replacement of the feeder.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_handledelaydetona: Throw or ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to activate 4s delayed detonation.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_ancienthhspear: A huge wooden-handled spear. The carefully carved wooden handle is exuding an ancient atmosphere, and the spearhead is cast from refined metal.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_steelmaul: Forged from steel, it has incredible destructive power, can effectively penetrate armor, and cause ‖color:gui.orange‖Broken‖end‖ damage to the target.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_baseballbatbarbed: A baseball bat densely wrapped with iron wires and steel nails firmly embedded, which can inflict one-stage ‖color:gui.orange‖Incremental Stun‖end‖ when hitting the target.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_cleaver: A fierce machete. ‖color:gui.blue‖Double Clicking RMB‖color:end‖ will get into the charging state, during which the movement speed increases and melee attack power strengthens.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_flamethrower: It has extremely high lethality in open areas and effectively suppresses the enemy, and hitting the target will cause ‖color:gui.orange‖Hindered‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_gassuffocationgre: A biological weapon filled with poison gas that will quickly cause suffocation upon inhalation of a large amount, and can cause serious damage to organs in the body. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the striker lever.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_smokegrenade: After detonation, a large amount of smoke is rapidly generated, which not only obstructs the enemy's vision, but also has the effect of extinguishing fire. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the striker lever.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_hellfiregrenade: A deadly weapon filled with incendium material and sealed under high pressure, which will emit a burst of fire and cause widespread damage when it explodes. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the striker lever.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_jcoffdef1fraggren: Specially used for outpost defense and clearing operations, it uses a "K"-type 5s delay fuse, and when it explodes, it will cause explosive damage within a range of 6 meters and fragmentation damage up to 13 meters. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the grenade spoon.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_flashbang: A non-lethal weapon that generates blinding light and high-decibel noise to obstruct the target's vision and hearing. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the striker lever.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_impactgrenade: A grenade that explodes on impact, its design is inspired by a traditional baseball, making it easy for everyone to throw accurately. It utilizes an impact fuse of 0.4s safety limit and a 5s delay fuse. To use, please ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to pull the safety pin and release the grenade cap.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_beartrap: Originally a tool used to capture land creatures, it has now become a low-cost and practical anti-invasion method for pirates.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_electrictimerdeto: A detonator that use an electric control module to delay. To use it, first attach it to a wall and then place an explosive inside.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_dynamitestick: Equipped with a small 5s fuse detonator. ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to ignite or extinguish it.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_dynamitesticktrip: A triple dynamite stick of 7s fuse. ‖color:gui.blue‖Click Use Key‖color:end‖ to ignite or extinguish it.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_dynamitespear: An explosive spear designed for the harpoon gun, equipped with a small 5s fuse detonator.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_boundingantiperso: The mine is cylindrical in shape and comprises a projectile tube, propellant, mine body, and fuse. When installing, ensure that the pressure rod is exposed above the ground.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_alientrappsychosi: Upon activation, it reduces the movement speed of nearby targets, also causes psychosis, and puts them in ‖color:gui.orange‖Incapacitated‖end‖ state.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_smgroundboreblast: Filled with explosive, imitating .45 caliber SMG round in shape. It explodes upon firing.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_assaultrifleround: Filled with explosive, imitating 6.8mm cartridges in shape. It explodes upon firing.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_cardiotonic: A strong anti-stun drug whose effects last about a minute.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_stungundartactive: A stun dart that contains a dormant phagosome that eats away at biological tissue and can be awakened by electrode pulses.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_frankensteinarmy: An army of "artificial humans" created by the mad scientist Frankenstein, stitched together from corpse parts and reanimated by electric shock. They are typically depicted as a monstrous legion—eerie, silent, immensely powerful, but of low intelligence—obedient to their creator.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_frankensteinarmyc: A terrifying device that transforms corpses into cyborgs—a grotesque product of modern technology.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_frankensteinarmyr: Used to repair damaged units of Frankenstein's Army. It can also be used to restore destroyed units, but the item will be consumed upon use. Holding it aloft will attract nearby Frankenstein's Army units.
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_powerfuldash: When you ragdoll while walking fast, will immediately stun nearby targets for [strength] seconds. The cooldown time is [interval] seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_disableforceloot: You cannot select an enemy character that is not knocked down.
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_frontlineaid: You can use saline more effectively.
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_battlemedic: For each enemy within [range] meters, healing effectiveness of medical items increases by [value]%, multiplicatively stacking up to [stack] times (approximately [stackedvalue]% max).\nGain additional [skilldependent] equal to [skillpercentage]% of your [skillindependent].
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_riotcontrol: The nearest ally within [range] meters of you indoors gains [physicalresistancevalue]% [physicalresistancename].
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_huntersmark: When hitting a target with harmful projectiles of the [itemname] class, inflict [affliction], reducing their [stattype] by [amount]% for [duration] seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.otfx_shootout: When being damaged by [affliction], your pistol lethality increases by [damage]% for the next [duration] seconds.\nWhile holding a pistol and not sprinting, take [resistanceforgunshotwound]% less [gunshotwoundname] and [resistanceforstun]% reduced [stunname] effect.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_riotcontrol: You are ready to suppress a riot.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_fohnsquad: The subject is able to handle heat.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_broken: The repair of most damages will be severely blocked, but this condition can be gradually alleviated over time.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_incapacitated: Unable to interact with some items.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_deepwound: The wound is deepening, and if it is not treated in time, it will cause serious damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_fallintodange: You are in danger, and your damage resistance is greatly reduced.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_prey: You exude a unique aura that spans a vast area, provoking the savagery of monsters and enticing them to chase and hunt you. Furthermore, you will suffer more damage from bite.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_activemasclep: Highly active muscles induce phagosomes to reproduce, causing deep tissue injury. When muscles are relaxed, phagosomes gradually decay.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_gassuffocatio: The respiratory system is suppressed and cannot get enough oxygen.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_smokegrenades: Under the cover of smoke, it is difficult for monsters to see you, and your melee damage will increase as your concealment increases, also extinguish the flames on your body.
infotexts.entitydescription.otfx_geneticmaterialhy: Immune to acid burns, recovers [value]% of damage, burns, and blood loss every 5 seconds, but will become unstable for a certain period of time when taking damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_hydra: You have a powerful life force, can quickly recover from even severe injuries, also you will secrete and emit acid in response to being hurt.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.otfx_hydrainstabil: Regeneration is not complete and the body needs a long time to adapt.
